text:
maria: ACME follow-up: they want a "grace path" that accepts short inference bursts without billing surprises. Can we scope an MVP that keeps pools stable?

dan: Need precise defs: 'short' in seconds, token cap, and what counts as a burst (concurrency vs rate). Also want failure-mode matrix.

krish: Proposal for MVP: grace_path = tenant opt-in flag + two knobs: burst_window_s and token_cap. Runtime will attempt local demotion for requests within token_cap for up to burst_window_s. After window, normal quota enforcement. Fallback chain: quantized-same -> smaller-model -> reject.

krish: Quick RFC snippet:
```yaml
grace_path:
  enabled: true
  burst_window_s: 15
  token_cap: 1024
  demotion_order:
    - rwd-3b-quant
    - rwd-1b
    - reject
  scope: tenant_pool_only
```

olivia: From launch checklist: 1) e2e perf test (p95 demoted latency target <300ms), 2) billing emits `grace_demote` events and shows demotion cost on tenant invoice, 3) customer docs + opt-out API.

billing-bot: billing: emit event `grace_demote` with tags [tenant_id, orig_model, demoted_model, tokens, billed_model]. Nightly job must reconcile demotion credits.

dan: Ops concerns: demotion must not cause memory thrash. Prefer routing to prewarmed quantized worker inside same pool. Add guard: if demoted_worker_cpu > 80% or demotion_rate > 0.5%/10m, disable grace_path for pool for 5m.

ops-bot: monitor-bot: Added alert `grace_path_contagion` firing when demotion_rate > 0.5% and region RPC latency increases by >10% in 5m.

maria: Legal wants "best-effort demotion" language. Draft: "When enabled, Redwood may route requests to lower-capacity model variants on a best-effort basis to accommodate short bursts; this may affect latency and output characteristics."

krish: Owner checklist (MVP): - API flag `grace_path_v1` (tenant opt-in) - Console: show recent demotions + toggle - Runtime: implement burst_window + token_cap + local demotion - Telemetry: `grace_demote`, `grace_accepts`, `demoted_latency` - Ops: circuit-breaker rules + prewarm quantized workers - Billing: emit events + reconciliation job - Pilot: ACME + 1 internal tenant for 2 weeks

olivia: Prioritization: mark as high for Dedicated customers on pilot. If ACME signs pilot, pull into next sprint and allocate 2 SRE oncall cycles for rollout week.

dan: I'll write ops runbook and circuit settings. Krish, please include memory footprint and prewarm numbers in RFC.

maria: Meeting Friday 2pm to finalize RFC and pilot acceptance template. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
